completed: Normal goal/action delete APIs require loaded student/revision and current actor intent, call one authenticated-only RPC and validate exact deleted-row receipts. No raw fallback or automatic uncertainty retry.
Current student editing proof and role/relationship identity remain held through commit/rollback. Owner/admin needs explicit access; Partner-only, read-only and assignee-only deletion are denied.
Stale, wrong, repeated, suppressed or mismatched deletions cannot report success. Concurrent deletion/update and current-access removal are observed in native cross-session tests.

Existing other records, prior completion activity and report data are retained; current raw table policies/grants and old routines/triggers are preserved. One new authenticated-only routine adds no table or trigger changes.
The current eight-workstream overview is reconciled with existing evidence and the latest source; broader TF01–TF26 and deferred report polish/Parent Pilot/Pathway Snapshot remain retained.
remaining: Raw/cached/trusted table DELETE and other writer paths outside this RPC remain available under existing rules and need their own authority/identity review.
Normal creation/goal status, educator caseload, student/profile and BridgeForward review remain in P1; P2–P4 and other security/product/provider/legacy scopes remain open.
Final combined catalogue/canonical/ledger packaging, target preflight and ordered cutover, separately authorized hosted acceptance/staging rollout and production/main controls remain open.
